result.summary: Independently read lib/letflow/design/req052-instance-cancellation.md in full (not CODE-DESIGNER's handoff summary) and cross-checked it against shipped code and prior design docs. All 7 acceptance criteria map to concrete design elements (AC traceability table §14): AC1->Multi M4/M6/M7 + INV-EE52-1/5; AC2->M3 conflict + INV-EE52-2/3/4; AC3->M7+active_instance_guard reuse; AC4->§7.1's fully-traced two-direction race with exact resulting error tuples; AC5->§4's 'agreement by construction' reasoning; AC6->§10's required moduledoc SCOPE BOUNDARY text; AC7->§2's DELETE decision for both parallel_approval.ex and ApprovalSupervisor. No TBD/deferral language found (grepped for 'TBD'/'to be implemented'/'to be decided'/'placeholder' -- zero hits). Function signatures fully specified: @type cancel_attrs/cancel_opts/cancel_error/cancel_result and @spec cancel_instance/3 in §3, with an exhaustive tagged-tuple error taxonomy. Cross-module dependencies tabulated in §13. No implementation code present -- grepped for 'def '/'defp '/Repo./Multi.new and confirmed every hit is prose citation or a Multi-step-table cell describing shape, not an actual function body; only @type/@spec blocks appear as code. Open questions listed explicitly, not silently resolved: OQ-1..OQ-6 (§11) plus the mandated §15 process-termination question. Independently re-derived the design's central claim -- that REQ-045 resolved 'no live per-instance process,' making the OPEN QUESTION's premise moot for this requirement -- by reading lib/letflow/design/req045-instance-start-engine-shell.md §1 directly ('create/2 is a plain function on a new context module... No :gen_statem, no DynamicSupervisor, no per-instance process is introduced by this requirement') and lib/letflow/instance_supervisor.ex's shipped moduledoc ('Currently supervises no children... REQ-045 resolved the S3 running-instance shape to a plain transactional context module'); both independently confirm the design doc's §15 restatement rather than a silent sweep-aside. Also verified the SUPERSESSION disposition (§2) against the actual shipped lib/letflow/parallel_approval.ex (a real :gen_statem, confirmed) and lib/letflow/approval_supervisor.ex (a real DynamicSupervisor, confirmed), and against lib/letflow/application.ex lines 24-25, which do list both Letflow.InstanceSupervisor and Letflow.ApprovalSupervisor as current children -- matching the design's claim of what ELIXIR-DEV must edit. Verified the M1-before-M2 lock-ordering claim (tasks before instance_projections) against complete_task/3's actual shipped Multi (lib/letflow/engine.ex lines 834-885, fetch_and_lock_task before fetch_and_lock_instance_projection, both using lock("FOR UPDATE")). All checks pass; no BLOCKER issues found.
